Added the step `Then the username field displays an inline message "Username is required" & the password field displays "Password is required"` to `features/steps/login.py`. It checks both fields independently, collects any missing messages, and raises a combined AssertionError if either (or both) are absent — so the test fails if "Username is required" or "Password is required" is not displayed.HAS_CHANGES
